title: Name, birthplace and start in music
summary: Handy gives his name, birth in Mississippi in 1900, and says he has played since age ten.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Just tell your name and where you were born and when.

My name is John Handy. I was born in Paschke, San, Mississippi in 1900. The exact day? The 24th day of June. I made the 25th day of June of 58. I've been fooling around with music since I was 10 years old.
